blocks.text: One disputed reading connects the human dominion described in verses 4–6 with the Messiah’s final victory: the Messiah is the firstfruits, those who belong to him follow at his arrival, hostile powers are abolished, and death is the last enemy defeated. On this reading, the passage contributes to a hope centered on resurrection and the defeat of death, not on praising suicide, preventable mortality, or bereavement.
